name: centipede
_about: The brown centipede (Lithobius forficatus), 3 cm long: flat and glossy chestnut; fifteen pairs of legs, one to each trunk segment, the plates on its back alternately long and short; a flat head with long many-jointed antennae and the poison claws (forcipules) curving round beneath it; the last pair of legs long, trailing behind as feelers. Its legs step in a wave that runs back down the body. Written whole by tools/creaturegen/rework/insects/bugs.py on insectlib.py (jointed legs on a walking gait, the antennae on bones of their own that wave).
